purpose: Frozen diagnostic test of cross-subband agreement and boundary evidence; no fitting or selection
mask: Original full-band 2% peak amplitude mask intersected with disjoint subband. Lower inclusive, upper exclusive except last band upper inclusive. Each subband retains original >=12 bins per pair and LS validity thresholds.
full_candidate: Frozen cap150 from prior failed narrowband-guard study; diagnostic subject only, not accepted default
boundary: After consistency, require maximum cone angle across full candidate and every valid subband <=30deg+1e-10. This envelope is not a calibrated confidence interval or probability.
scope: 144 paired trials,3 new seeds. Fixed screens only veto original candidates; no replacement, widening, retuning or confidence calibration. All rejected/absent/transition frames still update tracker.
reporting: Report unsupported/inconsistent/boundary-uncertain separately. Check outside active fresh outputs, inside correct coverage, exactly-30deg boundary, legitimate narrowband availability, HOLD and paired latency. Lower false output with near-zero coverage is not success.
